bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
state="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-entry/sticker-entry.json"
if test -f "$state";then
 python3 - "$state" <<'PY'
import sys,json
j=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
print('STK04_CREATE_RECEIPT_STATUS='+str(j.get('status','UNKNOWN')))
print('STK04_CREATE_RECEIPT_MESSAGE_ID='+str(j.get('messageId') or 0))
PY
else echo STK04_CREATE_RECEIPT_STATUS=ABSENT;fi
if docker image inspect create-videobot:sticker-topic-pin >/dev/null 2>&1;then echo STK04_CREATE_IMAGE_BUILT=YES;else echo STK04_CREATE_IMAGE_BUILT=NO;fi
printf 'STK04_LAST_CREATOR_CONTAINERS\n'
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'videobot|create' | head -n 8 || true
if command -v docker >/dev/null;then docker compose version | head -n 1;fi
echo STK04_CREATE_POST_FAILURE_AUDIT_DONE
